title: RML-G1 selected-slice control-ceiling repair
summary: Repair one constructibility error discovered before model dispatch: retain the empirical P ATOMS_REC 0/2 gate, but replace the impossible claim that a two-side P slice has structural success capacity 0/2 with an exact enumerated capacity and witness. Clarify that every supplied-gold store is built only from the sealed public source before target selection.
system_thesis: A causal gate is useful only if its pre-dispatch structural claims are true. Observed model failure and information-theoretic impossibility are different estimands and must remain separate.

context_files.purpose: Verbatim owner instruction to continue autonomous paper-directed work and reserve human intervention for genuine taste decisions.
Binding architecture-change, review, and GPU gate contract.
The exact G1 consensus whose T03 selected-slice clause contains the inconsistency.
The human-approved G1 scope that remains binding except for the proposed narrow amendment.
Replayable constructibility finding and the narrow proposed repair.

nodes.before: T03 is required to certify P ATOMS_REC exactly 0/2 as though that empirical gate were a structural capacity of the selected two-side P slice.
nodes.after: T03 enumerates and records the exact best visible-policy capacity for NONE_REC and P ATOMS_REC, with replayable successful-policy witnesses; T05 separately applies the preregistered empirical model-outcome gates.
nodes.rationale: Every two-side H/twin P slice admits a fixed nine-action solution for one side, so its structural capacity is at least 1/2 and cannot be 0/2.

nodes.before: R03 requires a source-only pretarget builder, but an implementation could appear target-blind while accepting hidden TargetSpec fields.
nodes.after: The builder accepts only the sealed public source and registered semantic reference; passing target, side, useful-pair, transform, valve truth, score, or plan objects is forbidden and hidden-target mutations cannot change store/query/visible bytes.
nodes.rationale: Target-independent supplied gold cannot be synthesized from the evaluation target's hidden answer.

edges.before: A structural capacity assertion of P ATOMS_REC 0/2 is treated as a prerequisite for the same observed 0/2 threshold.
edges.after: The frozen exact capacity and its witness contextualize the observed 0/2 threshold but do not predetermine it; any mismatch is reported, never repaired after dispatch.
edges.rationale: Separating construct capacity from model behavior preserves both the falsifier and honest interpretation.

loops.before: Preflight blocks unless it can prove the selected P ATOMS_REC arm has exact structural capacity 0/2.
loops.after: Preflight blocks unless it exactly enumerates each selected control's true visible-policy capacity and emits witnesses; dispatch then retains the original 18 trajectories, 234 opportunities, and empirical 0/2 P ATOMS_REC gate without retries or reselection.
loops.trigger: The narrow amendment is ratified, source-only construction and exact enumeration pass, and all original G1 prerequisites pass.
reads: sealed public source and semantic reference
sealed selected-slice public views and action protocol
original ratified G1 roster and empirical gates
writes: exact capacity certificate with replayable policy witnesses
loops.stop_condition: Stop before any model call on source/target leakage, failed enumeration, missing witness, review rejection, or any original G1 stop condition.
loops.rationale: The repair removes a false mathematical prerequisite without widening the model run.

claims.before: P ATOMS_REC 0/2 may be described as both a fixture-guaranteed ceiling and an observed model result.
claims.after: P ATOMS_REC 0/2 is only a preregistered observed result required for this gate; the separately reported exact two-side structural capacity and successful-policy witness are not paper evidence and cannot be called a zero ceiling.
claims.evidence_needed: A frozen exhaustive capacity certificate, independent review, and the unchanged no-retry empirical gate.

cells.reason: This is the only content authority for supplied-gold and atoms stores.
The certifier models each arm's exact source-derived visible information.
The resolver sees only rows returned for its emitted keys, never the source corpus itself.
Hidden evaluation truth cannot construct supplied memory.
Offline exhaustive capacity certification must compare policies against all hidden side transitions before model dispatch.
Neither the capacity witness nor hidden target or score may enter cognition.

acceptance_tests.setup: Enumerate deterministic visible policies over the selected NONE and P ATOMS information classes under four reads and nine public actions; replay every claimed lower-bound witness and independently verify the upper bound.
acceptance_tests.expected: The artifact reports the true exact capacities, including P ATOMS capacity at least 1/2, and never relabels empirical 0/2 as structural impossibility.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The repaired preflight still encodes a mathematically false control ceiling.

acceptance_tests.setup: Build and seal stores before target selection from public source/reference inputs, then mutate and permute all hidden target fields while comparing snapshot, index, query-universe, handle, and all model-visible bytes.
acceptance_tests.expected: All pretarget store and serving bytes are identical under hidden-target mutations; the builder API cannot accept a target or scorer object.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The supplied-gold control contains evaluation answers derived from its target rather than source-supported rows.

acceptance_tests.setup: Diff the repaired roster, prompts, resource/model limits, opportunity registry, interventions, empirical thresholds, and claim whitelist against the original ratified G1 consensus.
acceptance_tests.expected: Only the impossible capacity assertion and target-builder ambiguity change; empirical P ATOMS_REC remains 0/2 and every other original G1 boundary is byte-equivalent or stricter.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The repair covertly widens or makes the gate easier after design inspection.

human_boundary.decision_question: Ratify the narrow correction that preserves empirical P ATOMS_REC 0/2 but reports the selected two-side arm's actual exact structural capacity and forbids any target-derived GOLD construction, with no other G1 expansion?
forbidden_before_approval: GPU canary or scientific model dispatch
claiming P ATOMS_REC has a zero structural ceiling
using target-derived evaluation truth to build GOLD or ATOMS rows
changing any other G1 roster, threshold, prompt, model, seed, resource, intervention, or claim
